meta.floorRule: 3-digit room number: first digit is the floor (IST 518 -> 5). 2-digit numbers (IST 20, IST 21) are assumed Ground floor (floorInferred=true).
meta.roomRule: A cell's own room if written in the timetable (labs, e.g. 'LAB-108/309' occupies both 108 and 309); otherwise the section's home venue. FN sections use their home room only in periods 1-4 and AN sections only in 6-9, so shared rooms (e.g. IST 518 FN/AN) never overlap.
meta.acAndCapacity: The timetables contain NO air-conditioning or capacity data. ac and capacity are null (unknown) unless someone fills them in by hand.
meta.scope: Only rooms that appear in the 10 provided timetables are known. 'Available' means no class from these 13 sections is scheduled there; other departments may still use the room.
